    How to move · map legendTap the map or mini map to walk, or swipe the map to walk in a direction. Gold ! is your story quest, blue ! a job or trial target, green ? where to hand in a finished job, red ! a siege, white ! guild work on offer, gold ? a rumored place. Heal for a little gold at any town, hamlet or shrine without losing time. Places: ⚖ town (full market) · ⌂ hamlet (inn, one merchant) · ⛺ trader's camp · ⚑ faction keep · ✚ shrine · ⛏ mine · ☠ crypt · ✦ guild hall · ✓ cleared. Towns, shrines and friendly keeps have waystones for fast travel. Your homestead is in Emberfall. Glowing red walls of ash open as you finish chapters.
